Can I request samples or customization?
Send your sample quantity or customization requirements with your color-size mix. Feasibility, charges, packing or logo options and any applicable minimums are confirmed before quotation.

The listing minimum is 2 pairs. Indicative prices are USD 13.44 for 2-49 pairs, USD 12.54 for 50-99 pairs and USD 11.65 for 100 or more pairs. Final quotation depends on the color-size mix, packing and agreed order terms; freight and taxes are confirmed separately.
